name: Aki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Aki city emblem in white: a winged device with a pointed top above a ring enclosing a small device.
history: Municipal flag of Aki, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 14 June 1955.

features.role: Aki city emblem — a winged device with a pointed top above a ring enclosing a small device
